summary: Download the automation dashboard containerized setup bundle from the Red Hat downloads page, copy it to the RHEL host, extract it with `tar -xzvf ansible-automation-dashboard-containerized-setup-bundle-...tar.gz` (about 500 MB) and install ansible-core with dnf.
